body:
Hand-off from child 5 (#25752, the cutover procedure) to this card, 2026-10-26T07:50Z.

The switch is complete: `ui/` is on `main` (#25825), 4a #25745, PR B #25827 and 4b PR 2 #25834 are merged, the required set reads 8 live / 0 / 0 with no retired gate (Type Check UI, Lint UI and Build & E2E UI added; Test UI advisory per ruling 30 = B), and objectui is archived with the migration notice as its README head (#25854).

**Expected version of the first joint release: 18.2.0.** Both scopes are at 18.1.0 on `main` (`packages/spec`, `ui/packages/core`). The root `.changeset/` carries 55 minor and 84 patch bumps, so the fixed group moves one minor.

What this card still needs before the Version PR is cut, all already filed:
- #25831 (re-scoped by item 28 = B): one consolidated root changeset that names the public `@object-ui/*` packages as `minor`. Until it lands, a Version PR would not bump `@object-ui/*`, because changesets does not read `ui/.changeset/`.
- #25832: the objectui skill bundle moves into the root `skills/` catalog (decision C).
- The release npm token's publish rights on `@object-ui` and the docs-site deploy (#25752 step 6, maintainer settings).

The Version PR is merged only by a human. After it publishes, this card closes #25556 as superseded and then the epic #25677.

Release timing (maintainer ruling), recorded 2026-10-26T12:51Z: 「我计划进行中的任务都开发完，再发 18.2」 (Tesla, project chat, 2026-10-26T12:51Z). 18.2.0 is cut only after the in-progress work is finished.

So this card **holds**. Nobody opens, pushes or asks for a merge of the joint Version PR when #26097 (#25832) lands. If the changesets bot refreshes a Version PR on its own, it stays unmerged until the maintainer says release.

State of the two prerequisites:
- #25831 is done (#26068 merged; the 38 public `@object-ui/*` packages ride the next Version PR).
- #25832 is approved and queued (#26097).

D1 work still in flight before the release, all on #25712 (4b), one PR at a time: 2e liveness ledger (in work), 2f spec tests, 2g one sdui-parser, 2h AGENTS.md + ui/AGENTS.md (Tier H), 2i. The expected version stays 18.2.0 unless one of these carries a `major`, which the no-major guard refuses anyway.

**D1 blockers for 18.2 are cleared: 2026-10-27T02:32Z**

## 维护者速读

D1 这边挡 18.2 的工作已经全部合入:#26343(2g PR 2)合入 80f267d4,#26367(2i PR B)合入 e931621a1,#25712 和 #26137 都已关闭。按你 12:51Z 的裁定,什么时候合并 Version PR #25640 由你决定(只能由人来合)。合并并发布后,请执行 `npm deprecate @object-ui/sdui-parser "moved to @objectstack/sdui-parser"`。

## Detail

The hold on this card (6416455214) waited for 2g and 2i, per ruling B on #25712. Both are done:

- 2g: #26221, #26211, and #26343, which merged at 2026-10-27T02:29Z.
- 2i: #26315 and #26367, which merged at 2026-10-27T01:27Z.

With #26343, `@object-ui/sdui-parser` left the fixed group. The 18.2 Version PR therefore no longer bumps it, and npm keeps it at 18.1 until the deprecate above.

From D1's side, nothing else blocks the Version PR. The maintainer's rule that 18.2 follows the end of all in-progress work still applies across the other lanes.

The closing record on #25712 (6432294556) moves its residual cleanup (F12, F14, F18–F20, F23, F27, the 2h list) to this card's "cleanup leftovers". None of it blocks the release.
